examples.en: A dog is a popular pet.
examples.zh: 狗是一种很受欢迎的宠物。

examples.en: She keeps a rabbit as a pet.
examples.zh: 她养了一只兔子当宠物。

mnemonic.tip: pet 也作动词"轻抚"，在家里逗着抚摸的小动物就是宠物。

examples.en: Lions are wild animals.
These flowers grow wild.

mnemonic.tip: wild 谐音"外的"——在野外自由生长、没被驯的就是野生的。

examples.en: We saw pandas at the zoo.
examples.zh: 我们在动物园看到了熊猫。

examples.en: The zoo has many rare animals.
examples.zh: 这家动物园有许多珍稀动物。

mnemonic.tip: zoo 谐音"入"——两个 o 像两只圆眼睛，进去看动物的地方就是动物园。

examples.en: The bird flew out of its cage.
The rabbit lives in a cage.

mnemonic.tip: cage 谐音"凯奇"——一根根栏杆围成、关动物的就是笼子。

examples.en: The bird spread its wings.
A butterfly has colourful wings.
examples.zh: 蝴蝶有色彩斑斓的翅膀。

mnemonic.tip: wing 谐音"文"——扇动起来"呼呼"的、能飞的就是翅膀。

examples.en: The dog wagged its tail.
A monkey uses its tail to climb.

mnemonic.tip: tail 谐音"泰欧"——和 tale(故事)同音，长在动物屁股后头的就是尾巴。

examples.en: The cat has soft fur.
The rabbit's fur is white.

mnemonic.tip: fur 谐音"服"——毛茸茸像给动物穿了件"服"就是皮毛。

examples.en: A bee is a useful insect.
examples.zh: 蜜蜂是一种有益的昆虫。

examples.en: Insects have six legs.

mnemonic.tip: in(进入)+sect(切，同 section)，身体被"切"成一节节的小虫就是昆虫。

examples.en: Bees make honey.
A bee flew into the room.

mnemonic.tip: bee 拟声"嗡"——"嗡嗡"采蜜的就是蜜蜂。

examples.en: A butterfly landed on the flower.
Butterflies have beautiful wings.

mnemonic.tip: butter(黄油)+fly(飞)，像一小片黄油翩翩飞舞的就是蝴蝶。

examples.en: A spider is making a web.
She is afraid of spiders.

mnemonic.tip: spider 谐音"斯派德"——八条腿结网抓虫的就是蜘蛛。

examples.en: A snake moved through the grass.
Some snakes are dangerous.

mnemonic.tip: snake 谐音"斯内克"——s 的形状像蛇身弯弯扭扭，"嘶"地吐信就是蛇。

examples.en: The frog jumped into the pond.
Frogs eat insects.

mnemonic.tip: frog 拟声"呱"——"呱呱"叫、蹦蹦跳的就是青蛙。

examples.en: The rabbit has long ears.
Rabbits love to eat carrots.

mnemonic.tip: rabbit 谐音"拉比特"——长耳朵、蹦蹦跳的就是兔子。

examples.en: The cat is chasing a mouse.
Click the left button on the mouse.

mnemonic.tip: mouse 谐音"毛斯"——复数是 mice；电脑上那个也叫 mouse(鼠标)。

examples.en: A wolf lives in the forest.
Wolves hunt in groups.

mnemonic.tip: wolf 谐音"乌夫"——复数 wolves，月夜"嗷呜"长嚎的就是狼。

examples.en: A fox has a bushy tail.
examples.zh: 狐狸有一条毛茸茸的尾巴。

examples.en: The fox is a clever animal.

mnemonic.tip: fox 谐音"发克斯"——尖脸大尾、机灵狡猾的就是狐狸。

examples.en: The bear caught a fish.
Bears sleep all winter.

mnemonic.tip: bear 谐音"贝尔"——大块头、毛乎乎、力气大的就是熊(也作动词"忍受")。

examples.en: The lion is the king of animals.
A lion roared in the distance.

mnemonic.tip: lion 谐音"赖恩"——一头金色鬃毛、"嗷"地一吼的就是狮子。

examples.en: A tiger has black stripes.
Tigers are strong and fast.

mnemonic.tip: tiger 谐音"太哥"——山中"大哥"，带条纹、威风凛凛的就是老虎。

examples.en: The elephant has a long trunk.
Elephants are the largest land animals.
examples.zh: 大象是最大的陆地动物。

mnemonic.tip: elephant 谐音"艾勒粪特"——长鼻大耳、体型巨大的就是大象。

examples.en: The monkey climbed the tree quickly.
Monkeys love bananas.

mnemonic.tip: monkey 谐音"忙奇"——上蹿下跳、拿着"钥匙(key)"般灵巧的就是猴子。

examples.en: A giraffe has a very long neck.
examples.zh: 长颈鹿有非常长的脖子。

examples.en: Giraffes eat leaves from tall trees.
examples.zh: 长颈鹿吃高树上的叶子。

mnemonic.tip: giraffe 谐音"吉拉夫"——脖子老长、够得着高处树叶的就是长颈鹿。

examples.en: Dolphins are very clever.
We watched dolphins in the sea.

mnemonic.tip: dolphin 谐音"多芬"——在海里跃出水面、聪明友好的就是海豚。

examples.en: A shark has sharp teeth.
Sharks live in the ocean.

mnemonic.tip: shark 谐音"沙克"——里面藏 sharp(锋利)，满口尖牙的就是鲨鱼。

examples.en: The eagle flew high in the sky.
An eagle has very sharp eyes.

mnemonic.tip: eagle 谐音"伊狗"——展翅高飞、目光如炬的就是鹰。

examples.en: An owl hunts at night.
The owl sat quietly on a branch.
examples.zh: 猫头鹰静静地停在树枝上。

mnemonic.tip: owl 谐音"傲"——大眼圆睁、夜里"咕咕"叫、一脸高冷的就是猫头鹰。

examples.en: The parrot can say hello.
Parrots have bright feathers.

mnemonic.tip: parrot 谐音"派若特"——会学人说话、羽毛鲜艳的就是鹦鹉。

examples.en: Don't feed the animals at the zoo.
examples.zh: 不要给动物园的动物喂食。

examples.en: She feeds her cat twice a day.

mnemonic.tip: feed 是 food(食物)的动词亲戚，把食物递给动物就是喂养(过去式 fed)。

examples.en: Cats hunt mice.
Wolves hunt together.

mnemonic.tip: hunt 谐音"狠特"——悄悄追、狠狠扑抓猎物就是捕猎。

examples.en: The sea is full of strange creatures.
examples.zh: 大海里满是奇怪的生物。

examples.en: A frog is a small creature.

mnemonic.tip: creat(创造，同 create)+ure，被大自然创造出来的活物就是生物。

examples.en: There are cows and sheep on the farm.
My uncle works on a farm.

mnemonic.tip: farm 谐音"翻"——"翻"土种地、养鸡养牛的地方就是农场。

examples.en: A white feather fell from the bird.
examples.zh: 一根白羽毛从鸟身上落下。

examples.en: The peacock has beautiful feathers.

mnemonic.tip: feather 谐音"飞热"——轻飘飘、能助飞的就是羽毛。

examples.en: The horse is gentle and tame.
Wild birds are not tame.

mnemonic.tip: tame 谐音"泰姆"——被养熟、乖乖听话的就是驯服的。

examples.en: The cat sharpened its claws.
Eagles catch food with their claws.

mnemonic.tip: claw 谐音"克劳"——尖尖弯弯、一挠一抓的就是爪子。

examples.en: The bird held a worm in its beak.
A parrot's beak is strong.

mnemonic.tip: beak 谐音"比克"——鸟脸前面尖尖硬硬、啄食用的就是鸟嘴。

examples.en: The cat sleeps on my bed every night.
Our cat catches mice in the garden.
examples.zh: 我们的猫在花园里抓老鼠。

examples.en: The dog wags its tail when I come home.
They walk their dog twice a day.
She rides a horse at the weekend.
The horse jumped over the fence.
The cows come in for milking at five.
A cow eats grass all day long.
The hills are full of white sheep.
Sheep eat grass on the hillside all day.
examples.zh: 绵羊整天在山坡上吃草。

mnemonic.tip: sheep 单复数同形——a sheep, two sheep。

examples.en: The pigs rolled happily in the mud.
Pigs are cleverer than people think.
The goat climbed onto the roof of the shed!
Goat's milk is good for you.

mnemonic.tip: goat 谐音"够特"——山羊爬高上低，特别能干。

examples.en: The hen laid three eggs this morning.
The hens run to Grandma when she brings corn.
examples.zh: 奶奶端来玉米时母鸡们跑过去。

mnemonic.tip: hen 母鸡下蛋；cock 公鸡打鸣；chicken 统称/鸡肉。

examples.en: The chickens live in a little wooden house.
We keep six chickens for eggs.
The goose chased the postman across the yard.
Geese fly south in autumn.

mnemonic.tip: 复数特殊：goose→geese，类比 foot→feet。

examples.en: The donkey carried baskets up the hill.
Donkeys are patient, hard-working animals.
examples.zh: 驴是有耐心、能干活的动物。

mnemonic.tip: donkey 谐音"蹲剋"——倔驴蹲着不走，急死人。

examples.en: Camels can walk for days without water.
examples.zh: 骆驼可以数日不喝水行走。

examples.en: We rode camels across the desert.

mnemonic.tip: camel 谐音"看没喝"——骆驼看着就没喝水，也能走。

examples.en: A deer stood still at the edge of the forest.
Deer run fast when they hear a sound.
examples.zh: 鹿一听到声音就飞快跑开。

mnemonic.tip: deer 单复数同形；与 dear(亲爱的)同音。

examples.en: The squirrel buried nuts under the tree.
A grey squirrel ran up the trunk.

mnemonic.tip: squirrel 谐音"死快跑"——松鼠见人就飞快跑上树。

examples.en: A hedgehog rolled into a ball in the garden.
examples.zh: 刺猬在花园里缩成一团。

examples.en: Hedgehogs come out at night to find food.

mnemonic.tip: hedge(树篱)+hog(猪)→树篱下的小"猪"→刺猬。

examples.en: Bats fly out of the cave at sunset.
He hit the ball hard with the bat.

mnemonic.tip: 一词两义：会飞的 bat 蝙蝠，打球的 bat 球棒。

examples.en: A rat ran across the underground platform.
examples.zh: 一只老鼠跑过地铁站台。

examples.en: Rats are much bigger than mice.
examples.zh: 大老鼠比小老鼠大得多。

mnemonic.tip: rat 大老鼠，mouse 小老鼠——地铁里的多半是 rat。

examples.en: My hamster stuffs food into its cheeks.
examples.zh: 我的仓鼠把食物塞进腮帮子。

examples.en: The hamster runs on its wheel all night.

mnemonic.tip: hamster 谐音"憨死它"——腮帮子塞满食物，憨态可掬。

examples.en: The goldfish swims round and round its bowl.
examples.zh: 金鱼在鱼缸里游来游去。

examples.en: She won a goldfish at the fair.
examples.zh: 她在游园会上赢了一条金鱼。

mnemonic.tip: gold(金)+fish(鱼)→金色的鱼→金鱼。

examples.en: Sea turtles swim thousands of kilometres.
The turtle laid its eggs on the beach.

mnemonic.tip: turtle 谐音"驮头"——海龟驮着壳慢慢游。

examples.en: The tortoise beat the hare in the old story.
examples.zh: 在古老的故事里乌龟赢了兔子。

examples.en: A tortoise can live for over a hundred years.

mnemonic.tip: tortoise 陆龟(爬)，turtle 海龟(游)——龟兔赛跑是 tortoise。

examples.en: A little lizard sat on the warm rock.
examples.zh: 一只小蜥蜴趴在温热的石头上。

examples.en: The lizard dropped its tail and ran.

mnemonic.tip: lizard 谐音"立扎的"——蜥蜴立在石上一动不动像扎住。

examples.en: The crocodile waited silently in the river.
Crocodiles have existed since dinosaur times.
examples.zh: 鳄鱼从恐龙时代就存在了。

mnemonic.tip: crocodile 谐音"卡壳的嘴"——大嘴一合把猎物卡住。

examples.en: The blue whale is the largest animal ever.
examples.zh: 蓝鲸是有史以来最大的动物。

examples.en: We watched whales jumping from the boat.
examples.zh: 我们在船上看鲸鱼跃出水面。

mnemonic.tip: whale 谐音"喂喔"——鲸鱼喷水像在打招呼。

examples.en: An octopus has eight arms and three hearts.
examples.zh: 章鱼有八条腕和三颗心脏。

examples.en: The octopus changed colour to hide.

mnemonic.tip: octo(八)+pus(足)→八条腿的动物→章鱼。

examples.en: Crabs walk sideways along the beach.
A crab pinched my toe in the sea!
examples.zh: 海里一只螃蟹夹了我的脚趾！

mnemonic.tip: crab 谐音"卡拉钳"——挥着钳子的横行将军。

examples.en: The jellyfish glowed in the dark water.
examples.zh: 水母在黑暗的水中发光。

examples.en: Don't touch a jellyfish—it stings!

mnemonic.tip: jelly(果冻)+fish(鱼)→果冻一样的"鱼"→水母。

examples.en: Penguins slide on the ice on their bellies.
examples.zh: 企鹅用肚子在冰上滑行。

examples.en: The father penguin keeps the egg warm.

mnemonic.tip: penguin 谐音"喷跟"——企鹅摇摇摆摆跟着队伍走。

examples.en: Seals lay on the rocks in the sun.
examples.zh: 海豹躺在礁石上晒太阳。

examples.en: The seal balanced a ball on its nose.

mnemonic.tip: seal 海豹；同拼写还有"印章/密封"义——考试常见。

examples.en: Ants can carry things fifty times their weight.
examples.zh: 蚂蚁能搬动自身五十倍重的东西。

examples.en: A line of ants marched across the path.
examples.zh: 一队蚂蚁列队穿过小路。

mnemonic.tip: ant 蚂蚁与 aunt(姨妈)音近——别拼混。

examples.en: A fly kept landing on my sandwich.
examples.zh: 一只苍蝇老往我三明治上落。

examples.en: The frog caught the fly with its tongue.
examples.zh: 青蛙用舌头捉住了苍蝇。

mnemonic.tip: 动词"飞"和名词"苍蝇"同拼写——苍蝇就是很会飞。

examples.en: A mosquito bit me three times last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚蚊子咬了我三个包。

examples.en: Mosquitoes love warm, wet places.
examples.zh: 蚊子喜欢温暖潮湿的地方。

mnemonic.tip: mosquito 谐音"没死祈祷"——被拍的蚊子没死，快祈祷。

examples.en: Birds pull worms out of the wet grass.
examples.zh: 鸟从湿草地里拽出蚯蚓。

examples.en: Worms make the soil healthy.

mnemonic.tip: worm 谐音"我姆"——软软的小虫扭来扭去。

examples.en: The snail carries its house on its back.
After rain, snails come out onto the path.

mnemonic.tip: 网络时代普通邮寄被叫 snail mail(蜗牛邮件)——够慢。

examples.en: A red ladybird landed on my hand.
examples.zh: 一只红瓢虫落在我手上。

examples.en: Ladybirds eat insects that harm plants.

mnemonic.tip: lady(淑女)+bird(鸟)→穿红点裙的"淑女鸟"→瓢虫。

examples.en: Two white swans swam under the bridge.
examples.zh: 两只白天鹅从桥下游过。

examples.en: The ugly duckling became a beautiful swan.
examples.zh: 丑小鸭变成了美丽的天鹅。

mnemonic.tip: 芭蕾舞剧《天鹅湖》英文就是 Swan Lake。

examples.en: Pigeons gather in the town square.
A pigeon flew in through the classroom window!
examples.zh: 一只鸽子从教室窗户飞进来了！

mnemonic.tip: pigeon 谐音"劈枝"——鸽子落在树枝上，枝头压弯。

examples.en: Sparrows chirp on the wire every morning.
examples.zh: 麻雀每天早上在电线上叽喳。

examples.en: A sparrow picked up crumbs under the table.
examples.zh: 一只麻雀在桌下啄面包屑。

mnemonic.tip: sparrow 谐音"死扒喽"——麻雀满地扒食吃。

examples.en: A seagull stole my chips at the beach!
examples.zh: 海鸥在海滩抢走了我的薯条！

examples.en: Seagulls followed the fishing boat.

mnemonic.tip: sea(海)+gull(鸥)→海上的鸥→海鸥。

examples.en: The kitten chased its own tail.
examples.zh: 小猫追着自己的尾巴转。

examples.en: Our cat had four kittens last week.
examples.zh: 我们的猫上周生了四只小猫。

mnemonic.tip: kitten 小猫，puppy 小狗——幼崽有专门的词。

examples.en: The puppy chewed Dad's slipper.
Puppies need lots of sleep and play.
examples.zh: 小狗需要大量睡眠和玩耍。

mnemonic.tip: puppy 谐音"扑劈"——小狗见人就扑上来。

examples.en: The lion cub practised roaring.
The mother bear watched her cubs closely.

mnemonic.tip: cub 谐音"卡布"——毛茸茸的小奶熊。

examples.en: The bird built its nest under our roof.
There are three blue eggs in the nest.

mnemonic.tip: nest 谐音"垒斯特"——一根根垒起来的家→鸟巢。

examples.en: The spider's web shone with morning dew.
examples.zh: 蛛网上的晨露闪闪发光。

examples.en: A fly was caught in the web.

mnemonic.tip: 蜘蛛网 web 和互联网 the Web 是同一个词——都是"网"。

examples.en: The turtle pulled its head into its shell.
We collected shells on the beach.

mnemonic.tip: shell 谐音"歇喽"——乌龟缩进壳里歇着。

examples.en: The bull has sharp curved horns.
The driver sounded his horn loudly.

mnemonic.tip: 牛角 horn 和汽车喇叭 horn 同词——最早的喇叭用兽角做。

examples.en: The dog gave me its paw to shake.
The cat cleaned its paws carefully.
examples.zh: 猫仔细清理自己的爪子。

mnemonic.tip: paw 谐音"跑"——小猫小狗靠四只 paw 跑。

examples.en: A cat's whiskers help it feel its way.
The rabbit's whiskers twitched.

mnemonic.tip: whisker 谐音"喂食可"——猫胡须一动，就知道该喂食了。

examples.en: Whales are mammals, not fish.
Mammals feed their babies with milk.
examples.zh: 哺乳动物用乳汁喂养幼崽。

mnemonic.tip: mammal 谐音"妈喂"——妈妈喂奶的动物→哺乳动物。

examples.en: Snakes and lizards are reptiles.
Reptiles need the sun to warm their bodies.
examples.zh: 爬行动物靠晒太阳取暖。

mnemonic.tip: reptile 谐音"爬得踏"——贴地爬行的动物。

examples.en: The dog barks at every stranger.
The old tree's bark is rough and grey.

mnemonic.tip: 一词两义：狗叫 bark，树皮也是 bark。

examples.en: The lion roared and the forest went quiet.
We heard the roar of the waterfall.

mnemonic.tip: roar 谐音"吼啊"——狮子大吼。

examples.en: Careful—that dog may bite.
The apple has a bite taken out of it.

mnemonic.tip: bite-bit-bitten——蚊子咬的包叫 a mosquito bite。

examples.en: A bee stung me on the arm.
examples.zh: 一只蜜蜂蜇了我的胳膊。

examples.en: The sting hurt for hours.

mnemonic.tip: sting 谐音"死叮"——蜜蜂死命一叮→蜇。

examples.en: The cat scratched the new sofa.
There's a scratch on my arm from the bushes.
examples.zh: 灌木在我胳膊上划了道印子。

mnemonic.tip: scratch 谐音"死抓痕"——抓出痕来。

examples.en: A beetle crawled across the table.
The baby is learning to crawl.

mnemonic.tip: crawl 谐音"快喽"——宝宝爬得快喽。

examples.en: Turtles lay their eggs in the sand.
Our hens lay eggs every day.

mnemonic.tip: lay-laid-laid 下蛋；lie(躺) 不带蛋——别混。

examples.en: The chicks hatched after twenty-one days.
examples.zh: 小鸡孵了二十一天破壳。

examples.en: We watched the eggs hatch one by one.
examples.zh: 我们看着蛋一个个孵化。

mnemonic.tip: hatch 谐音"孵出"——小鸡孵出壳。

examples.en: Pandas rarely breed in zoos.
examples.zh: 熊猫在动物园很少繁殖。

examples.en: What breed is your dog?

mnemonic.tip: breed 谐音"不理的"——动物繁殖不理人。

examples.en: We took the kitten to the vet for a check.
examples.zh: 我们带小猫去兽医那里检查。

examples.en: The vet gave the dog an injection.

mnemonic.tip: vet 是 veterinarian 的缩写——动物的医生。

collocations: take a pet to the vet

examples.en: They got their dog from an animal shelter.
examples.zh: 他们的狗是从收容所领养的。

examples.en: The animal shelter needs volunteers at weekends.
examples.zh: 动物收容所周末需要志愿者。

mnemonic.tip: animal(动物)+shelter(庇护所)→流浪动物的家。

examples.en: Keep your dog on a lead in the park.
examples.zh: 在公园里要给狗拴上牵引绳。

examples.en: The puppy pulled hard on its lead.

mnemonic.tip: lead 领路——牵着狗"领"它走的绳子；注意与 lead(铅)/led 区分。

examples.en: The dog sleeps in its kennel outside.
We leave our dog at the kennels when we travel.
examples.zh: 旅行时我们把狗寄养在犬舍。

mnemonic.tip: kennel 谐音"啃喽"——狗在窝里啃骨头。

examples.en: The baby panda is impossibly cute.
examples.zh: 熊猫宝宝可爱得不得了。

examples.en: What a cute little hamster!

mnemonic.tip: cute 谐音"可爱到哭"——太可爱了。

examples.en: The tiger looked fierce but stayed calm.
examples.zh: 老虎看起来凶猛却很平静。

examples.en: A fierce dog guards the factory gate.
examples.zh: 一只凶猛的狗守着工厂大门。

mnemonic.tip: fierce 谐音"非饿死"——猛兽饿了非常凶。

examples.en: Horses are gentle if you treat them kindly.
Be gentle with the baby rabbits.

mnemonic.tip: gentle 谐音"真透"——温柔得让人心里真透亮。

examples.en: Wild bears are dangerous—keep away.
It's dangerous to swim near crocodiles.
examples.zh: 在鳄鱼附近游泳很危险。

mnemonic.tip: danger(危险)+ous→充满危险的。

examples.en: The south China tiger is extremely rare.
It's rare to see an owl in the daytime.

mnemonic.tip: rare 谐音"稀啊"——稀有啊。

examples.en: The furry rabbit felt like a cloud.
examples.zh: 毛茸茸的兔子摸起来像云朵。

examples.en: He loves all furry animals.
examples.zh: 他喜欢一切毛茸茸的动物。

mnemonic.tip: fur(皮毛)+ry→长满毛的→毛茸茸的。
